styles.music: Instruments: tuned mallets (marimba, vibraphone, glockenspiel, glass), a round bass, a short synthetic kick and small dry percussion. Precise and dry outside the object; sustained and airy inside it.
fits: battery cells; solar tiles; the drawers of a modular shelf
the back of a logic board; the inside of a drone arm; the underside of a sensor module
a pressure sensor in a shoe; a gasket in a waterproof case; a motor driver
the thickness of a laptop lid; the footprint of a router; the bore of a valve

styles.look: A real-looking place photographed from high above with a tilted lens and a time-lapse camera, so the whole world reads as a tabletop model.
styles.music: Ensemble: tuned percussion carries the style (marimba, glockenspiel, vibraphone, woodblocks, kalimba, celesta), pulse-based and minimalist (Reich grammar: phasing, voices added one at a time, pulsing chords), plus plucked strings or a small reed section. Not…
fits: one worker finishing a shift; a child dropping an ice cream; a proposal on a crowded pier
a courier through a market; a single wrong-way skier; one boat leaving port
a port unloading ships; an airport's turnaround; a farm harvest
ferries crossing a bay; runners with headlamps; lanterns along a river

styles.look: Edo-period woodblock prints brought to life: flat colour blocks, carved ink lines, bokashi skies, paper you can feel, and a camera that moves over the print like an unrolling handscroll.
styles.music: Japanese instruments, not piano and pads: shamisen (core/audio/pluck.py shamisen, with sawari buzz), shakuhachi, koto, taiko and shime-daiko, kotsuzumi / ōtsuzumi calls, hyōshigi (wooden clappers), a small bell.
fits: one building through a century; a product in five homes; the same street in four seasons
a supply chain; the stations of a pilgrimage; the steps of a recipe
a building going up; an idea taking shape; a character being "made" for the story
a snowfall that erases a town; forgetting; a clean start

styles.look: A sketchbook page drawn on location: fine sepia fineliner lines that wobble, overshoot and never quite close, with loose transparent watercolour dropped on top. The colour sits slightly off the lines, spills over them,…
styles.music: Music families: a jazz waltz (walking bass in three, brushes, piano, clarinet or flute); a café accordion trio; solo nylon guitar; a string quartet pizzicato; a brass band for crowds. One colour instrument per area of the page works well.
fits: a cathedral façade; a chef plating a dish; a street musician
a sunrise over a harbour; a parade moving down a street; the lights of a market switching on
a red umbrella in the rain; a yellow taxi; a child's kite
a travel diary entry; a neighbourhood portrait; a day in a place

styles.look: A hand-painted journal page that paints itself: translucent brush strokes with dry-brush flying white on warm cotton paper, hand-written notes beside what is painted, nothing drawn with a vector line.
styles.music: Music: acoustic and gentle: felt piano, fingerpicked guitar, woodwinds, light strings, glockenspiel, kalimba, soft pads. A licensed track can be edited with beat-aligned jumps; the picture can then take its beat grid.
fits: the stages of a building; the ingredients of a dish; the organs of a body
a festival crowd; a field in bloom; a city lighting up
pollution along a river; temperature by altitude; noise across a city
a tool kit; a wine region's grapes; parts of a bicycle

styles.look: A pure white massing model of a real place stands on a plinth in a dark room, and a projector paints data onto it as light: one layer at a time, falling on the surfaces that face it, spilling a little past the plate.…
styles.music: The room: room tone, the projector fan (hum + filtered air) rising when the lamp strikes, relays for the house lights, a lamp strike (zap + thump), the air of a light wash (sliding band-passed noise).
fits: a site before and after; a district before a plan is shown; any "now look closer"
a war-damaged centre; a flood plain with no housing; land a company owns; a protected zone
a new town's growth; a campus master plan by phase; a port's expansion; a developer's portfolio by year
building heights; sea-level or flood depth; floor counts; a height limit being tested

styles.look: An explainer drawn live on one glossy dry-erase board: single-line handwriting that is actually written stroke by stroke, floating markers with no hand, magnets that can move, an eraser that can rewind, and a camera…
styles.music: Music options: a solo piano figure; a small jazz trio with brushes; plucked strings and kalimba; a synth arpeggio for tech topics; clockwork minimalism (marimba, pizzicato, woodblock, glockenspiel). Mickey-mouse details: a rising whistle for growth, pings for…
fits: compound interest; the Drake equation; a recipe's ratios
a nerve signal; a supply chain; the water cycle
a delivery truck on a route; a cell in a bloodstream; a player on a pitch
an undo in software; reversing a chemical reaction; "what if we hadn't…"

styles.look: A relief print that carves itself: every frame is a black wood block, and light only exists where a knife has cut it away. One colour at most, and only for the thing that burns.
styles.music: Instruments: low strings (contrabass, cellos; spiccato, pizzicato), wood and skin (log drum, woodblock, frame drum), gran cassa, timpani, one tam-tam, synthesised struck metal (modal: 3–5 inharmonic partials + hammer transient); a bowed saw or hurdy-gurdy…
fits: a power grid switched on; a scientific insight; a lighthouse restored
a year of training; a building rising; a craft apprenticeship
a vote result; a name cleared; a misunderstanding put right
stars going out over a city; rain stopping; a disease receding on a map
